title: Only squash merges are allowed
rationale: One commit per pull request keeps history linear and the changelog readable.
hint: Settings > General > Pull Requests: allow squash merging only.

title: Merged branches are deleted automatically
rationale: Stale branches hide what is in flight.

title: The default branch is protected from force pushes and deletion
rationale: History on main must not be rewritable.
hint: Protect the default branch; see docs/repo-setup.md.

title: Changes reach main through pull requests with required checks
rationale: The CI gates only matter if merging without them is impossible.

title: Branches must be up to date before merging
rationale: A green check on a stale branch says nothing about the merged result.

title: Secret scanning with push protection is on
rationale: A secret that never gets pushed never has to be rotated.

title: Dependabot alerts are enabled
rationale: Known-vulnerable dependencies should reach you before an audit does.

title: The default workflow token is read-only
rationale: Workflows should get write rights only where a job asks for them.

title: Administrators follow the branch rules
rationale: Rules with an admin bypass are suggestions. Solo maintainers may waive this one.
